title: Raggie embeddings gateway contract
description: Wire contract of services/embeddings (the single internal embedding gateway) shared by the Go edge, the Python workers and the control-plane tests. All endpoints live under {EMBEDDINGS_BASE_URL} (e.g. http://embeddings:8002/v1). When the gateway requires auth (default in cloud mode) every /v1/* call needs 'Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_API_SECRET'; /healthz, /readyz and /metrics are open. Additive fields may appear in any response; clients MUST ignore unknown fields. Collections: the legacy profile (local intfloat/multilingual-e5-large, dim 1024, E5 prefixes, no extra JSON; fingerprint 2872ae6a) keeps 'raggie_chunks_d1024'; every other profile is 'raggie_chunks_d{dim}_{fingerprint}'. Callers MUST use the 'collection' the gateway returns instead of deriving it from the vector length, and MUST treat a fingerprint different from the one their data was indexed with as a terminal mismatch (re-embed required).

fingerprint.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON {provider, model, dim, query_prefix, passage_prefix, request_extra, query_extra, passage_extra} (sorted keys, no whitespace), first 8 hex chars. Upstream URL and API key are excluded.

collection.description: Qdrant collection for vectors of this profile.

EmbeddingsRequest.description: POST /v1/embeddings (OpenAI-compatible). input_type 'query' or 'passage' (default; any other value is treated as passage) selects prefixes / extra JSON.

SparseRequest.description: POST /v1/sparse — BM25 document vectors (always computed locally).

SparseResponse.description: Empty indices/values when sparse is disabled: index dense-only.

QueryRequest.description: POST /v1/query — dense + sparse for ONE search query.

RerankResponse.description: Best-first, truncated to top_n. Score scales differ per provider; rely on the order only. While the reranker is loading/disabled/failing the gateway returns the identity order (still HTTP 200).

InfoResponse.description: GET /v1/info — the active embedding profile. dense_host/rerank_host are the hostnames document text is sent to (null = stays on this server).

ReadyResponse.description: GET /readyz — 200 {status: ready}; 503 {status: loading} before the first probe, 503 {status: not_ready, reason} when the probe failed (e.g. dimension mismatch). Re-probed every 30s until it passes.

ErrorResponse.description: Non-2xx body. 401: missing/invalid internal bearer. 429 (+ Retry-After header, seconds): the cloud upstream is rate-limiting/unavailable — back off and retry (passages). 502: the upstream rejected the request or answered malformed (not retryable). 503: query upstream unavailable.
